Agendas, Minutes and Attachments

 

Available on the Council's Electronic, Agenda, Minutes and Attachment System are the following documents administered for Council Meetings.

  • Agendas: An Agenda produced to include a Report on all items to be considered or noted by Council at its Meeting.
  • Attachments: Attachments to the Reports documented in the Agendas or Minutes including plans, photographs, pictures etc.
  • Minutes: The minutes of the Council Business Items which documents the Resolutions of Council made when addressing the Reports/Attachments tabled in the Agenda and any other Council business items raised at the Meeting.

Agendas, Minutes and Attachments 2025

 

Available on the Council's Electronic, Agenda, Minutes and Attachment System are the following documents administered for Council Meetings.

  • Agendas: An Agenda produced to include a Report on all items to be considered or noted by Council at its Meeting.
  • Attachments: Attachments to the Reports documented in the Agendas or Minutes including plans, photographs, pictures etc.
  • Minutes: The minutes of the Council Business Items which documents the Resolutions of Council made when addressing the Reports/Attachments tabled in the Agenda and any other Council business items raised at the Meeting.
